data.name: Anushka
data.gender_notes: Anushka is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anushka is a Sanskrit name that means blessed with good fortune. It is a popular name in India and is often given to girls born into families who believe in the importance of good luck and prosperity. The name Anushka carries the meaning “Blessed with good fortune” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Anushka usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with good fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anushka is a name that signifies the answer to a prayer or a ray of hope. It is a light in the darkness, providing guidance and illumination to those who seek it. This name is deeply spiritual and is often associated with the divine.
data.etymology: Anushka belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with good fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anushka total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
